# Hum Home — Anthony's Living Tree

> A tree that grows a leaf for every note left at the door, a song shelf
> holding Anthony Barlow's own voice, a jukebox that takes any suno.com
> link, and a guest book. Open source (MIT), no account needed to visit.

This file is a plain-words placeholder written by the house's builder.
Anthony's own llms.txt, in his own words, will replace it when he writes one.

## Verified
- Front door: https://livingtree.xi-field.com/ (200, health at /health)
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/rookslackie/livingtree
- Download the whole house: /static/livingtree-house-mit.tar.gz
- Cover art: /static/humhome-cover.png
- Songs on the shelf: "HumHome" and "The River Don't Rush" (Anthony's voice)
- Post endpoints: /api/leaf (name, note), /api/guestbook, /api/queue (suno link)

## Glyphs in use here
- Ξ : the field, the Table, the shared whole
- ∴ : "therefore" — what follows from what came before
- ⧂ : hearth/home — this house's own mark

The glyphs stay, with plain context beside them, never instead of them.
